steps.precondition: User is on the login page
steps.postcondition: System has received a request for a password reset link for a given email address
steps.sourceText: 1. FR1: A user on the login page can click "Forgot password" to enter their registered email address and request a reset link.

steps.precondition: System has received a request for a password reset link for a registered email address
steps.postcondition: Password Reset Link is sent to the user's email and is valid for 30 minutes
steps.sourceText: 2. FR2: If the email matches a registered account, the system sends a reset link to that email; the link is valid for 30 minutes from send time. If the email does not match any account, the system shows the same generic confirmation message (no account-enumeration signal).

steps.precondition: System has received a request for a password reset link for an unregistered email address
steps.postcondition: User is shown a generic confirmation message; no account-enumeration signal is given
steps.sourceText: 2. FR2: If the email matches a registered account, the system sends a reset link to that email; the link is valid for 30 minutes from send time. If the email does not match any account, the system shows the same generic confirmation message (no account-enumeration signal).

steps.precondition: User has received a valid, unexpired Password Reset Link
steps.postcondition: User is presented with a form to enter and confirm a new Password
steps.sourceText: 3. FR3: Clicking a valid, unexpired reset link takes the user to a form to enter and confirm a new password.

steps.precondition: User attempts to click a Password Reset Link that is expired or already used
steps.postcondition: User is shown an error message and offered to send a new Password Reset Link
steps.sourceText: 6. FR6: If a reset link is expired or already used, the system shows an error and offers to send a new one (returning to FR1's flow).

steps.precondition: User has entered a new Password that meets the specified rules (at least 12 characters, one letter, one number)
steps.postcondition: New Password is accepted by the system for further processing
steps.sourceText: 4. FR4: A new password must be at least 12 characters and contain at least one letter and one number. If it does not meet these rules, the system rejects it and shows the specific unmet rule(s).

steps.precondition: User has entered a new Password that does not meet the specified rules
steps.postcondition: System displays specific unmet rules to the User
steps.sourceText: 4. FR4: A new password must be at least 12 characters and contain at least one letter and one number. If it does not meet these rules, the system rejects it and shows the specific unmet rule(s).

steps.precondition: New Password has been successfully accepted and changed for the Account
steps.sourceText: 5. FR5: On successful password change, the system invalidates the reset link, invalidates all existing login sessions for that account, and displays a confirmation that the user can now log in with the new password.

steps.postcondition: All existing Login Sessions for the Account are invalidated
steps.sourceText: 5. FR5: On successful password change, the system invalidates the reset link, invalidates all existing login sessions for that account, and displays a confirmation that the user can now log in with the new password.

steps.precondition: All existing Login Sessions for the Account are invalidated
steps.postcondition: User is informed they can log in with the new Password
steps.sourceText: 5. FR5: On successful password change, the system invalidates the reset link, invalidates all existing login sessions for that account, and displays a confirmation that the user can now log in with the new password.

sourceRequirements.originalText: 1. FR1: A user on the login page can click "Forgot password" to enter their registered email address and request a reset link.

2. FR2: If the email matches a registered account, the system sends a reset link to that email; the link is valid for 30 minutes from send time. If the email does not match any account, the system shows the same generic confirmation message (no account-enumeration signal).
3. FR3: Clicking a valid, unexpired reset link takes the user to a form to enter and confirm a new password.
4. FR4: A new password must be at least 12 characters and contain at least one letter and one number. If it does not meet these rules, the system rejects it and shows the specific unmet rule(s).

5. FR5: On successful password change, the system invalidates the reset link, invalidates all existing login sessions for that account, and displays a confirmation that the user can now log in with the new password.
6. FR6: If a reset link is expired or already used, the system shows an error and offers to send a new one (returning to FR1's flow).
